pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_loot/affix-workbench/BreakpointFilters.tsx:74 The breakpoint table filters on every keystroke with three filters (category, rarity, text), but its result count is a plain span, not a status message, and there is no single clear-all action, so a screen-reader user hears nothing as rows change and a sighted user must reset each filter separately.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_loot/affix-workbench/BreakpointFilters.tsx:74 Filtering per keystroke is legitimate here because all data is on the client, but the technique then requires the count to be a status message (SC 4.1.3); this one has no role=status or aria-live. The only reset is an 'All' option per filter, which the technique says is not a substitute for one clear action.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_loot/affix-workbench/BreakpointTable.tsx:95 The empty row says the filter is the cause but names no active filter and offers no one-tap clear. Its colSpan is 9+N, but the header has only 6+N columns.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_loot/affix-workbench/BreakpointTable.tsx:32 Everything runs on the client over the complete static AFFIX_POOL, so no axis is split across server and client.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_loot/affix-workbench/BreakpointTable.tsx:64 The cells are read-only text, so a native table is the right shape and no grid role is needed.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_loot/affix-workbench/BreakpointTable.tsx:31 The filtered and computed rows are derived in a memo keyed on the filter values, not stored in state.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_loot/affix-workbench/data.ts:68 The data is a static pool of roughly 20 affixes, too small to need a window.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_loot/affix-workbench/useExportActions.ts:36 The export writes generated C++ code, not table rows to CSV or a spreadsheet.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_loot/affix-workbench/useExportActions.ts:22 The clipboard receives generated code; no cell range is copied or pasted.
